description: Defines the RequireSettings class for resource management configuration in OrchardCore, including properties, constructors, and methods for resource positioning, attributes, dependencies, and merging settings.

classes.name: RequireSettings
classes.description: Represents configuration settings for resource requirements, including attributes, positioning, dependencies, and various configuration methods.

methods.name: AtHead
methods.description: Sets resource location to head of the page.

methods.name: AtFoot
methods.description: Sets resource location to foot of the page.

methods.name: AtLocation
methods.description: Sets resource location to a specified location.

methods.name: UseCulture
methods.description: Sets the culture for the resource.

methods.name: UseDebugMode
methods.description: Enables debug mode for the resource.

methods.name: UseDebugMode
methods.description: Enables or disables debug mode based on parameter.

methods.name: UseCdn
methods.description: Enables CDN mode for the resource.

methods.name: UseCdn
methods.description: Enables or disables CDN mode based on parameter.

methods.name: UseCdnBaseUrl
methods.description: Sets the CDN base URL.

methods.name: WithBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base path for the resource.

methods.name: UseCondition
methods.description: Sets a condition for resource inclusion.

methods.name: UseVersion
methods.description: Sets the version of the resource.

methods.name: ShouldAppendVersion
methods.description: Specifies whether to append version to resource URL.

methods.name: SetDependencies
methods.description: Adds dependencies for the resource.

methods.name: Define
methods.description: Defines inline resource configuration.

methods.name: SetAttribute
methods.description: Sets a custom attribute for the resource.

methods.name: MergeAttributes
methods.description: Merges attributes from another RequireSettings instance.

methods.name: UpdatePositionFromDependent
methods.description: Updates position based on a dependent's position.

methods.name: UpdatePositionFromDependency
methods.description: Updates position based on a dependency's position.

methods.name: CombinePosition
methods.description: Combines position settings from dependent and dependency.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new instance with current settings.

methods.name: NewAndCombine
methods.description: Creates a new combined instance with another RequireSettings.

methods.name: Combine
methods.description: Combines current settings with another RequireSettings.
